name: upstream binding transcription factor
pathways: transcription initiation at RNA polymerase I promoter

function.text: UBTF encodes nucleolar transcription factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase I general transcription initiation factor activity and chromatin binding. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase I and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase I promoter.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to childhood-onset motor and cognitive regression syndrome with extrapyramidal movement disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pheochromocytoma; Acute myeloid leukemia; B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
